title: mcp: the DATASET_SELECTION_RULE docblock stops saying the skill still carries its loose-form rows
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this session's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「立卡」, answering this session's list of four gaps nobody had carded. The gap was reported by the dispatching seat `repo:objectstack#3` on #34659 (comment 6960624063, item 1); the filer did not re-read the code behind it.

## Why

A comment that states something false about where a rule lives sends the next reader to the wrong file. It becomes false the moment PR #34977 lands, so it is not left as a nit.

## Evidence

- Per the report: the `DATASET_SELECTION_RULE` docblock in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts` ends "The skill's own loose-form rows predate candidates and are amended in its lane"; PR #34977 (#34868) deletes those rows.

## Scope

- One sentence: the docblock says what the skill carries after #34977. Land it right after that PR; it was kept out of it so that PR stays skills-only.

## Done when

- The docblock is true against the merged skill.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Related: #34868 (PR #34977).
